title: Symrise signs a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept
summary: - Contemplated acquisition accelerates Symrise towards a leading position in Premium Naturals and enhances its offering for Fragrance customers - Creates a distinctive, best-in-class Naturals cluster in Pays de Grasse by bringing together Floral Concept and Maison Lautier within its Fragrance division - Supports Symrise’s ONE Symrise strategy to drive for profitable growth, margin resilience and strong cash generation via active portfolio management

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 프리미엄 천연 향료 부문 입지 강화를 위해 플로럴 컨셉 인수를 위한 풋옵션 계약을 체결했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Symrise signs a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept
